scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd server && bun install --cwd client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client"
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd server lint && bun run --cwd client lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd client typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd server build && bun run --cwd client build
